title: Validating Student Microventures: An Evidence-Based Model for Product Positioning and Market Communication
abstract: Student entrepreneurship projects often culminate in attractive promotions before learners establish whether a product solves a meaningful problem. This conceptual practice article develops an evidence-driven market-to-message framework connecting customer problem, value proposition, minimum product evidence, selling conversation, and channel-appropriate message. It proposes a traceable claim system, classroom implementation sequence, and rubric focused on evidence, coherence, ethics, and iteration.
